fact: The yearbook states the annual school census was interrupted 2012/13-2014/15 and again from 2019 for lack of funding and COVID-19, and that a 2022 statistical campaign covering all establishments produced data for 2020/21 and 2021/22.
title: Annuaire Statistique, Fondamental 1, Alphabétisation et Education de base non formelle - 2021-2022
publisher: Ministère de l'Education Nationale (hosted by ICASEES)
